title: Install forward-retro and action map — 2026-11-15
content:
Purpose: quick forward-retro (what went well / pain) from the last 7 days of VPC/on‑prem installs, with a prioritized action map for next 10 calendar days. Keep this as a lightweight living doc for engineers + SEs; will promote a subset to the install playbook after validation.

Meeting: Field install pulse — weekly review
Date: 2026-11-15
Attendees: Maya Chen (owner), Diego Alvarez, Priya Nair, Owen Park, Tara Liu, SRE oncall
Objective: Triage lingering blockers, assign owners, and produce a risk-limited rollout plan for three active customers (AceroHealth, BlueRidge Retail, Zenith Financial).

High-level summary:
- Net: installs are progressing but show concentrated friction in networking and disk provisioning steps. Two customers (AceroHealth, Zenith) have delayed certificate/KMS handshakes that are blocking final acceptance tests.
- Positive: automated preflight script caught CUDA driver mismatch on one host — saved ~2 hours vs manual debug. Preflight adoption = 72% of scheduled hosts.
- Concern: we saw 3 repeat issues tied to ephemeral hostname resolution (split-horizon DNS); this is the most frequent outage cause during the last two installs.

Per-customer snapshot (current owner / blocker / next step):
1) AceroHealth — Owner: Tara Liu (SE) / Eng lead: Maya
   - Status: install in QA verification stage (post-deploy)
   - Blocker: customer KMS policy rejects our ARIntegration role; HSM cert exchange timed out during final keywrap (INF-1289 open)
   - Impact: cannot run end-to-end encrypted inference in private mode (SLA/policy holds)
   - Next step: Priya to run manual keywrap test with customer HSM vendor on 11/16; Tara to provide vendor contact; escalate if no progress by 11/18.

2) BlueRidge Retail — Owner: Diego Alvarez
   - Status: mid-deploy (3 of 6 nodes completed)
   - Blocker: split-horizon DNS causing ephemeral hostname resolution to point at internal mgmt network; appears to be a conditional forwarder missing (DEP-4021)
   - Impact: install agent fails at wake/registration step on nodes behind that forwarder (transient)
   - Next step: Diego to coordinate customer infra team to confirm conditional forwarder entries by EOD 11/16; if unresolved, perform temporary /etc/hosts mapping (approved fallback) and document for post-mortem.

3) Zenith Financial — Owner: Owen Park
   - Status: preflight passed; kernel-level perf issue surfaced during load test
   - Blocker: runc/container runtime on host uses older io_uring library, causing occasional eviction under high tokenization throughput
   - Impact: intermittent container restarts during stress tests (no data loss yet)
   - Next step: Owen to push a lightweight patch to our runtime shim to reduce open file churn and open INF ticket for vendor upgrade timeline; SRE to pin autoscaler configuration to reduce churn window.

Blocker heatmap (by frequency and risk):
- Networking: HIGH (split-horizon DNS, firewall rules, CIDR overlaps) — repeated cause across 4 installs last month
- KMS/HSM: HIGH — high-risk because it gates customer acceptance and compliance
- Drivers/Kernel/GPU runtime: MEDIUM — detectable by preflight but occasionally slips through due to custom host images
- Installer scripts / permissions: MEDIUM — a few permission edge-cases on older distros
- Build/artifact signing/time-sync: LOW — rare but high-impact when it happens

Forward-retro notes (what went well / what to change):
- Went well: preflight automation improved surface area of infra mismatches; new logging flag (--debug-attach) helped in two cases.
- Improve: need a clearer fallback ladder for DNS (documented temporary /etc/hosts approach and a network contact template).
- Improve: accelerate KMS handshake playbook (include HSM vendor test vectors, contact sheet, and sample IAM policies).
- Keep doing: SE + Eng pairing during final acceptance reduced handoff friction on staged installs.

Action map (priority ordered) — owner / due / acceptance criteria:
- A1: KMS/HSM immediate triage runbook (create and validate vendor test vectors + runbook) — Owner: Priya Nair / Due: 2026-11-18 / Criteria: can reproduce keywrap failure locally against vendor test harness and document workaround for customer. Linked: INF-1289.
- A2: DNS contingency doc + templated asks for customers (conditional forwarder checklist + hosts fallback) — Owner: Diego Alvarez / Due: 2026-11-17 / Criteria: doc published to Confluence and validated on next BlueRidge node. Linked: DEP-4021.
- A3: Runtime shim patch to reduce io churn + deploy to staging — Owner: Owen Park / Due: 2026-11-19 / Criteria: passes 30m stress test with zero container restarts.
- A4: Preflight adoption drive (increase to >90%) — Owner: SE lead (Tara) / Due: 2026-11-22 / Criteria: adoption metric in install dashboard shows >=90% for next wave.
- A5: Post-install playbook extract (promote validated fixes to playbook) — Owner: Maya Chen / Due: 2026-11-25 / Criteria: playbook updated and linked from install checklist. Linked artifacts: Confluence page.

Open questions / riskiest assumptions:
- Can we standardize a single acceptable HSM vendor interface for our Private customers, or must we continue to support multiple incompatible SDKs? (Impact: dev effort & support cost)
- Are customers willing to accept temporary /etc/hosts fallbacks for time-limited installs, or does procurement block that? Need legal sign-off for documented temporary configs.
- Do we have capacity windows to schedule kernel upgrades for hosts in regulated environments? If not, must widen our shim scope.

Notes-to-self / quick reminders:
- Remember to capture exact KMS error logs (time-stamped) from AceroHealth — Priya will attach to INF-1289.
- Add a small checklist item to preflight to detect io_uring library version and warn earlier.
- Remind SRE to disable aggressive autoscaler policy for Zenith until runtime patch is in.

Decisions made during sync:
- Use /etc/hosts fallback as an approved temporary mitigation for DNS issues (document and get legal sign-off for customers who restrict host file changes).
- Fast-track KMS triage as top priority for this week; ribbon to leadership if acceptance dates slip.

Follow-ups and owners recap (short):
- Priya: KMS triage & logs (due 11/18)
- Diego: DNS contingency doc + BlueRidge check (due 11/17)
- Owen: runtime shim + INF ticket (due 11/19)
- Tara: preflight adoption push (due 11/22)
- Maya: playbook extract + leadership note (due 11/25)

If anything urgent pops up, ping #field-installs and escalate to oncall.

End notes: this doc is intentionally action-heavy — keep it lean and re-run same template next week; I will convert validated motion into a playbook fragment after 11/25.

-- Maya
